edits.value_json: 四 means “four.” In its present form, an enclosing 囗 surrounds inner 儿-form strokes. A source describes Shang 亖 as four strokes used directly for “four”; the origin of the later graph 四 remains disputed. Proposals treat 四 as a breath-related graph for 呬 or as the original graph of 泗, later borrowed for “four”; the latter proposal lacks textual attestation.

四 means “four.” Its present form encloses inner 儿-form strokes within 囗. A source describes Shang 亖 as four strokes used directly for “four,” while the origin of later 四 remains disputed; one proposal makes 四 the original graph of 泗, later borrowed for “four,” but lacks textual attestation.
